title: Canonical finite sf point fibre in the normalized adic realization
statement: Use the normalized integral and point models of [def-zl-normalized-finite-fibre-models] and the normalized realization [def-zl-classical-lisse-restriction-models]. At a geometric point, extend the sf point normalization to the coefficient closure, use the extension-adjunction mate of the identity restriction-of-scalars comparison to reassociate tensors, then apply the normalized integral completed-pullback comparison. The resulting point-section object equals the recorded integral realization fibre object: both use the same Shrink coefficient field, coefficient transport, completed pullback, H0, final-object sections and actual scalar inclusion. Follow this equality by the inverse of the recorded integral fibre comparison and by the coefficient-equivalence unit and the fibre of the common-stage coefficient-model counit. This defines the canonical isomorphism from the extended finite sf H0 point fibre to the normalized realization fibre of the same stage inclusion. The construction uses no Weil structure, no classical point transport, and no freely chosen isomorphism.
